entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The English Reformation (c. 1534–1603) was the process by which England broke away from the authority of the Pope and the Roman Catholic Church. Initiated by Henry VIII's desire for annulment and executed through parliamentary statutes, it transformed English religion, politics, and culture.
